texts.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]和[Root.Leader.GetHisHer]的组员在研究[From.GetName]时获得了惊人发现：这颗被熔岩覆盖的星球上生活着能适应极端恶劣环境的有机体微生物群！这些细菌生活在火山口的最深处，它们很喜欢那里的高温环境。

这个前所未有的发现让我们第一次了解到熔融星球上竟然有蓬勃发展的有机体生物。而且，[From.GetName]的稀薄大气层中那异常宝贵的罕见气体也是这些微生物的新产代谢的副产品。
texts.en:
[Root.GetLeaderName] and [Root.Leader.GetHisHer] crew have made a surprising discovery on [From.GetName]: the molten planet is home to an exotic array of extremophilic microorganisms! These bacteria live deep inside the volcanic vents that scar the planet, thriving in the extremely high temperatures produced there.

This unprecedented find is our first known example of organic lifeforms flourishing on molten planets. Moreover, the extremophiles on [From.GetName] are in fact responsible for the rare gases detected in its thin atmosphere, producing these valuable compounds as a byproduct of their metabolic processes.

summary.text:
# 火山喷口 / Volcanic Vents

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:543-564; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:4478 (distar.145)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。无战略资源的熔岩星球可能生成（1级，权重1），null_spawn_chance 0.5。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on a molten planet without strategic resources (level 1, weight 1), null_spawn_chance 0.5.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.145“高温环境中的微生物”：火山喷口深处生活着嗜极微生物，正是它们代谢产生了稀有气体——首次发现熔岩星球上的有机生命。奖励社会学研究，星球获得奇异气体矿藏；随后 action.941 发送通用战略资源提示。30天后的通用接触报告 story.1 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

distar.145 "Extremophilia": extremophile microbes live deep in the volcanic vents and produce the rare gases — the first known organic life on a molten world. Rewards society research and an exotic gases deposit; action.941 then sends the generic strategic-resource notice. The generic contact report story.1 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.
